verdict.rationale: Workable is a SaaS recruiting platform with AI features (Workable Agent, AI candidate recommendations), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents any setting, policy or contract term that stops customer data from being used to train AI models. The API's 'full control over your data' claim is about programmatic data access, not AI-training consent, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
